Finished in iconic Rosso Corsa over a luxurious Beige Tradizione leather interior, and showing just 13,036 miles, this mid-engine Ferrari combines breathtaking twin-turbocharged V8 performance with sophisticated aerodynamics and unmistakable Italian craftsmanship.
The 488 GTB blends sculpted design with aerodynamic innovation derived from Ferrari's extensive motorsport experience. Finished in legendary Rosso Corsa, this example is enhanced by carbon fiber lateral air intake splitters, adding lightweight performance-focused detailing while accentuating the dramatic side air intakes that feed the powerful V8 engine.


Inside, the cabin is beautifully appointed in Beige Tradizione leather, creating an elegant contrast to the exterior. The carbon fiber driver zone with LEDs places Formula 1-inspired shift lights and controls directly at the driver's fingertips, while the carbon fiber center console adds lightweight motorsport character to the driver-focused cockpit.

Capable of accelerating from 0 to 60 mph in approximately 3.0 seconds, the 488 GTB delivers extraordinary acceleration, razor-sharp response, and exceptional handling through its advanced aerodynamic and electronic chassis systems.

Key Features:

• Carbon Fiber Lateral Air Intake Splitters: Lightweight exterior components emphasizing the 488 GTB's aerodynamic and motorsport-inspired design.

• Carbon Fiber Driver Zone with LEDs: Formula 1-inspired carbon fiber controls featuring integrated LED shift lights.

• Carbon Fiber Center Console: Lightweight interior trim adding a distinctive performance-focused accent to the cockpit.

This 2017 Ferrari 488 GTB is far more than just a car, it embodies Ferrari's commitment to breathtaking performance, advanced engineering, and timeless Italian design. Available at Ferrari Silicon Valley, this exceptional supercar offers an invitation to experience one of Ferrari's most celebrated twin-turbocharged V8 machines.

Finished in Pearl White over a Black interior, this 2017 Nissan GT-R Premium has been transformed into an exceptionally comprehensive R35 build combining upgraded OEM Nismo turbochargers, extensive E85 fueling, advanced suspension components, a full carbon ceramic brake conversion, premium forged wheels, and an aggressive collection of carbon fiber and KUHL exterior components. From the factory, the GT-R is powered by Nissan's hand-assembled 3.8-liter twin-turbocharged VR38DETT V6 producing 565 horsepower and 467 lb-ft of torque, paired with a rapid-shifting 6-speed dual-clutch transmission and ATTESA E-TS all-wheel-drive system. This example was factory equipped with Premium Paint and Carpeted GT-R Logo Floor Mats, resulting in an original MSRP of $112,880.

Performance has been substantially enhanced with OEM Nissan R35 Nismo turbos, creating a desirable factory-derived turbo upgrade for the VR38DETT platform. Supporting airflow modifications include a Boost Logic 3-inch intake system, Boost Logic Race intercooler with upgraded piping, TiAL Sport QR blow-off valves, and a Boost Logic coolant expansion tank. Fuel delivery has been comprehensively upgraded with Injector Dynamics 1300cc injectors, a Visconti Flex Fuel Kit, Visconti Speed Density Kit, Visconti fuel filters, TRP fuel pump hardware, a DW300C fuel pump, and a Spray It Racing fuel pressure monitor. The complete combination has been professionally calibrated on E85 through ECUTek by Bill Guthrie, while an AMS midpipe further improves exhaust flow and enhances the character of the twin-turbocharged V6.

Supporting modifications include a Radium triple catch can system, Antigravity lightweight lithium battery, and carbon fiber intake manifold cover. The chassis has been extensively developed with Swift Sport lowering springs, a Neko height-adjustable sleeve kit, SPL front upper control arms, Megan Racing rear camber adjustment, and upgraded sway bar hardware, providing extensive control over ride height, alignment, suspension geometry, and overall chassis balance while complementing the factory Bilstein DampTronic system.

Braking has received a major upgrade with a complete Nissan GT-R Carbon Ceramic Conversion Kit, adding lightweight, high-performance carbon ceramic braking hardware appropriate for the substantially upgraded performance of the vehicle. The GT-R rides on iconic 20-inch Volk Racing TE37 Saga S-Plus wheels finished in Bronze and secured with titanium lug nuts, creating a distinctive motorsport-inspired appearance and providing a dramatic contrast against the Pearl White exterior.

The exterior has undergone an extensive transformation with Kansei Service 25mm wider front fenders, a Liberty Walk Style carbon fiber hood, N-Tune carbon fiber front lip, Top Secret carbon fiber rear spoiler, Rexpeed carbon fiber fender vents, carbon fiber wrapped side skirts, and a custom rear diffuser. The rear aero package is further enhanced with KUHL V2 35R-SS Upper Rear Diffuser and Center Duct Rear Diffuser components, creating a much more aggressive and distinctive rear profile while complementing the broader carbon fiber theme of the build. A front tow hook adds another functional motorsport-inspired detail.

The vehicle is protected with full front-end PPF, rear bumper PPF, and Carbon PPF on the roof, helping preserve both the factory finish and extensive exterior modifications. Inside, a carbon fiber steering wheel provides a more performance-focused cockpit, while a 12V Solutions remote engine starter and TERUNSOUL front and rear dash camera system add modern convenience. The audio system has also been upgraded with dual JL Audio 10-inch subwoofers in a custom enclosure powered by a JL Audio MX500/1 amplifier with a dedicated bass control knob.

With over $117,000 invested, this GT-R Premium represents an exceptionally developed R35 build combining OEM Nismo turbo performance, comprehensive E85 fueling and supporting modifications, carbon ceramic braking, adjustable suspension and alignment hardware, Bronze Volk Racing TE37 wheels, extensive carbon fiber bodywork, aggressive KUHL rear aero, upgraded electronics, and comprehensive paint protection. Built upon the legendary VR38DETT and ATTESA E-TS platform, this 2017 GT-R delivers a distinctive combination of factory-derived performance hardware, serious supporting modifications, premium components, and unmistakable presence.

Lamborghini Paramus is proud to present this stunning 2008 Lamborghini Murcielago LP640 Coupe, showing approximately 5,602 miles. Representing one of the last great naturally aspirated V12 Lamborghinis developed before the modern era, the LP640 is an icon of Sant'Agata engineering, combining unmistakable styling, breathtaking performance, and an exhilarating analog driving experience that has become increasingly sought after by collectors and enthusiasts alike.

Powered by Lamborghini's legendary 6.5-liter naturally aspirated V12 producing 631 horsepower, the LP640 delivers an unforgettable soundtrack and performance through its all-wheel drive system and 6-speed transmission. Every drive is an event, with razor-sharp handling, dramatic scissor doors, and the unmistakable presence that has made the Murcielago one of the most celebrated supercars of its generation.

This example has been tastefully enhanced with a Capristo Racing Valved Exhaust System paired with Capristo Headers, allowing the driver to enjoy an aggressive exotic soundtrack while retaining the ability to control exhaust volume at the touch of a button. The system is complemented by ceramic-coated exhaust tips that provide both a premium appearance and increased durability.

Inside the cockpit, the car has been thoughtfully updated with a period-correct Kenwood double DIN multimedia system that integrates seamlessly into the interior while maintaining the character of the vehicle. Modern conveniences include SiriusXM satellite radio, a backup camera, and enhanced multimedia functionality without compromising the timeless design of the Murcielago's cabin. A professionally integrated Passport radar detection system further enhances long-distance touring capability.

Adding to its originality, the vehicle also includes its factory first aid kit, an often-missing accessory that collectors appreciate.

Most importantly, this Murcielago has been meticulously maintained. All scheduled maintenance is up to date and has been performed by Lamborghini Paramus' factory-certified Lamborghini technicians, giving the next owner confidence that the vehicle has received the level of care expected from an authorized Lamborghini dealership.

As one of the final flagship V12 Lamborghinis to deliver a truly raw, naturally aspirated driving experience without turbocharging or hybrid assistance, the LP640 continues to earn recognition as one of the most collectible modern Lamborghinis ever produced. With exceptionally low mileage, desirable performance upgrades, modern usability enhancements, and comprehensive servicing completed, this Murcielago represents an outstanding opportunity to acquire an increasingly rare piece of Lamborghini history.

We invite you to contact Lamborghini Paramus for additional information, a personalized video walkaround, or to schedule a private appointment to experience this exceptional Murcielago LP640 Coupe in person.

Finished in vibrant Giallo Modena over a purposeful Nero leather interior, and showing 28,829 miles, this naturally aspirated V8 berlinetta represents one of Ferraris most beloved modern classics, combining timeless Pininfarina styling with an exhilarating analog driving experience.
The 360 Modena marked a significant evolution for Ferrari, introducing an all-aluminum chassis and body that improved both performance and handling. Finished in the marques signature Giallo Modena, this example is enhanced by a Challenge grille, a popular Ferrari accessory inspired by the 360 Challenge race car that improves engine bay airflow while adding a distinctive motorsport-inspired appearance.


Inside, the cabin is beautifully appointed in premium Nero leather, creating a clean and driver-focused environment. Daytona style seats provide Ferraris iconic seat design with exceptional comfort and support, while electric seats offer convenient power adjustability. The minimalist cockpit places every essential control within easy reach, delivering a pure and engaging connection between driver and machine.

Engine and Performance: At the heart of the 360 Modena lies a naturally aspirated 3.6 liter V8 engine producing 395 horsepower and 275 lb-ft of torque. Paired with Ferrari's 6-Speed F1 automated manual transmission, the 360 Modena accelerates from 0 to 60 mph in approximately 4.5 seconds while delivering crisp throttle response and the unmistakable soundtrack that only a naturally aspirated Ferrari V8 can provide. Its lightweight aluminum chassis, balanced mid-engine layout, and precise steering continue to make the 360 one of the most rewarding Ferraris to drive.

Key Features:

• Challenge Grille: Motorsport-inspired rear grille design that enhances engine bay ventilation while adding a distinctive Ferrari Challenge appearance.

• Daytona Style Seats: Iconic Ferrari seating design offering timeless styling, comfort, and support.

• Electric Seats: Provide exceptional comfort and power adjustability for both driver and passenger.

This 2001 Ferrari 360 Modena is far more than just a car, it is the embodiment of the brand's commitment to peak automotive engineering and opulent design. 2022 Porsche 718 Cayman S: White, PDK, PASM, Sport Chrono, SportDesign, and Nearly $100k Original MSRP

This 2022 Porsche 718 Cayman S is exactly why the Cayman platform has earned such a serious reputation among Porsche enthusiasts.

Finished in White over Black, this Cayman S has the clean, aggressive look of a modern Porsche sports car, but the option list is what really makes it stand out. With an original total price of $99,840, this car was built far beyond a basic Cayman S. It was ordered with PDK, PASM lowered 10 mm, Sport Chrono Package, SportDesign Package in High Gloss Black, 20-inch Carrera S wheels, Power Sport Seats with 14-way adjustment and memory, Premium Package, BOSE Surround Sound, LED headlights with PDLS+, Lane Change Assist, ventilated seats, and a long list of gloss black and painted exterior details.

This is not just a Cayman S.

This is a sharp, well-optioned, enthusiast-friendly Porsche that looks right, drives right, and has the equipment that makes it feel special every time you get in.

Why the 718 Cayman S Is So Good

The 718 Cayman S is one of the best driver s cars Porsche makes because the fundamentals are so strong.

Mid-engine balance.
Compact size.
Precise steering.
Strong turbocharged torque.
A rigid coupe chassis.
Porsche build quality.
Everyday usability.

The Cayman S gives you the kind of balance and confidence that makes the car feel immediately natural. The engine is in the right place, the chassis responds quickly, and the car feels light on its feet in a way that bigger performance cars often do not.

It is fast, but more importantly, it is usable fast.

That is what makes it so much fun. You can enjoy this car on a backroad, on a commute, on a weekend trip, or every time you find an open on-ramp. It does not need to be saved for special occasions. It makes normal driving feel special.

The Turbocharged S Advantage

The 718 Cayman S uses a 2.5-liter turbocharged boxer-four rated at 350 horsepower and 309 lb-ft of torque.

That torque is a huge part of the appeal. The car pulls hard, responds quickly, and feels genuinely quick in real-world driving. You do not have to wring it out to enjoy it. The power is available, accessible, and easy to use.

That makes the Cayman S a perfect Porsche for someone who wants the precision of a sports car without needing GT-car intensity or 911 money.

It is quick enough to be exciting, refined enough to use often, and balanced enough to remind you why mid-engine Porsches have such a loyal following.

PDK Makes It Brutally Effective

This car was ordered with 7-speed Porsche Doppelkupplung, better known as PDK.

In a Cayman S, PDK is fantastic. It is smooth when you want comfort and lightning-quick when you want performance. It keeps the car in the powerband, reacts instantly, and makes the car feel incredibly sharp when paired with Sport Chrono Package.

The result is a Cayman S that is easy to drive every day but still feels serious when you push it.

PDK does not take away from the experience here. It makes the car more usable, more responsive, and more effective.

The Right Performance Options

This car has the options that matter.

PASM lowered 10 mm gives the car the right stance and a more focused chassis feel. Sport Chrono Package sharpens the personality and gives the cabin the signature dash-mounted stopwatch. GT Sport Steering Wheel gives the driver s seat a more focused feel. Sport Tailpipes in Black add to the look. The 20-inch Carrera S wheels, painted in High Gloss Black, give the car a much stronger presence.

This is the kind of option stack that turns a good Cayman S into a great one.

It is not just pretty. It is set up to drive.

The Look Is Excellent

The exterior spec is clean and aggressive.

White paint keeps the shape crisp and timeless, while the SportDesign Package in High Gloss Black, rear wing in High Gloss Black, door handles in High Gloss Black, window trim in High Gloss Black, side window trim preparation in High Gloss Black, rear side air intake grilles painted, and model designation painted give the car a much more customized look.

The black wheels and black trim completely change the attitude of the car. It looks lower, wider, sharper, and more purposeful.

Then you get the small details that make it feel even more special: Porsche crest on the headrests, Guards Red seat belts, white instrument dials, and a white Sport Chrono stopwatch dial.

This is a clean build with the right contrast.

Comfort and Daily Usability

One of the best things about this Cayman S is that it is not just a weekend toy. It was optioned to be usable.

The Premium Package adds the kind of comfort and convenience equipment that makes the car easy to enjoy often, including BOSE Surround Sound, power-folding exterior mirrors, Light Design Package, luggage net, Porsche Entry & Drive, Lane Change Assist, LED headlights with PDLS+, heated multifunction steering wheel, and ventilated seats.

The Power Sport Seats with 14-way adjustment and memory are another major plus. They give the car the support you want from a sports car with the comfort and adjustability you want from a premium Porsche.

That is the appeal of this build.

It is sporty, but not punishing.
Aggressive, but still tasteful.
Quick, but easy to live with.

Why Someone Should Buy This Cayman S

This Cayman S makes sense for someone who wants a Porsche that feels special every time they drive it without stepping into the price point of a GTS, GT4, or 911.

It has the mid-engine balance people love.
It has PDK.
It has Sport Chrono.
It has PASM.
It has the SportDesign Package.
It has great wheels.
It has a strong color combination.
It has nearly $100k original MSRP.
It has comfort options that make it genuinely usable.

This is the kind of car that reminds you that the Cayman S is not a consolation prize. It is a brilliant Porsche in its own right.

The chassis is fantastic. The power is strong. The size is perfect. The spec is excellent.

  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.

This 2024 Ford Mustang GT Premium is finished in Carbonized Gray Metallic over Space Gray & Black leather , has only 28K miles, a Clean Carfax , and pairs the 5.0L Coyote V8 with a 6-speed manual transmission. Then you get to the option sheet. 401A Premium Plus. Bronze Appearance Package. Active Valve Exhaust. Brembo brakes. Bang & Olufsen audio. Heated & Cooled Seats. The factory 19-inch bronze wheels look killer against Carbonized Gray, especially with the Red Brembo calipers and Satin Black racing stripes with their red accent. A handful of tasteful suspension, exterior and interior upgrades finish it off without taking away from what was already a very uniquely optioned Mustang. Carbonized Gray. Bronze wheels. Red accents. Three pedals. Some combinations just work. This Is Why Options Matter You can buy a lot of S650 Mustang GTs. Finding one configured like this is another story entirely. The Bronze Appearance Package is the visual centerpiece, giving an otherwise understated Carbonized Gray Mustang a completely different personality with its factory bronze-finished wheels. Then Ford layered in the good stuff. The 401A Premium Plus Package brings the higher-level cabin and technology experience you'd want in a GT Premium, complemented here by Bang & Olufsen premium audio, Heated & Cooled Seats, Ford Co-Pilot360 Assist+ and voice-activated touchscreen Navigation. And then there's the Active Valve Exhaust System. Quiet it down when you need to. Open it up when you don't. Exactly how a 5.0 Mustang should be. 6-Speed. Brembos. Better Suspension. This isn't just an appearance-spec Mustang. The 6-speed manual transmission keeps the experience properly old-school where it matters, while the Performance Brembo Brake Package adds the upgraded braking hardware and performance linings. The chassis has also received two worthwhile upgrades: Ford Racing Lowering Springs and an Eibach Front Sway Bar , tightening the stance and sharpening the handling without turning the car into an overbuilt project. That's the theme throughout this one. Good factory specification. Good supporting upgrades. Nothing excessive. Ford Racing Lowering Springs bring the car down to a more aggressive stance, while the Eibach Front Sway Bar adds a worthwhile chassis upgrade. Visually, an extended front chin spoiler and black Dark Horse-style rear spoiler give the S650 a little more aggression, complemented by carbon fiber exterior mirror caps and tinted windows. Inside, a carbon fiber and leather flat-bottom steering wheel is joined by carbon fiber door-handle grab trim. Nothing changes the basic character of the car. It just looks a little meaner than the one Ford delivered. description: Mashburn Motors is pleased to offer this exceptionally preserved 2008 Ford Mustang Shelby GT500 with just 14,130 original miles. Finished in beautiful Vapor Silver Metallic with Ebony Le Mans stripes, this two-owner GT500 has a clean, accident-free CARFAX and remains remarkably original, unmodified and unmolested — something becoming increasingly difficult to find among these early modern Shelby GT500s. Under the hood is Ford's supercharged 5.4-liter DOHC V8 producing 500 horsepower and 480 lb-ft of torque, backed by the original Tremec 6-speed manual transmission. The engine compartment remains factory in appearance, right down to the original air intake and supercharger arrangement. No cold-air intake, aftermarket pulley, tuner, exhaust system or collection of modifications to undo — this is the way Ford and SVT built it. The condition is exceptional throughout. The Vapor Silver paint and factory-style Ebony stripes present beautifully, the original GT500 wheels are outstanding, and the exterior shows the kind of preservation expected from a carefully kept 14,000-mile automobile. The black leather interior is equally impressive, retaining its original Shelby seating, factory Shaker audio system, instrumentation, trim and virtually every detail that made these cars special when new. Even underneath, this Shelby tells an honest story. Rather than having been cosmetically refinished or sprayed to look new, the undercarriage remains remarkably original, showing factory finishes, labels and components along with only the minor natural aging one would expect from an 18-year-old automobile. It's exactly the kind of underside we like to see on a genuine low-mile collector car. Documentation is another strong point. Included are the original window sticker, Ford/SVT documentation, owner's materials, keys and remotes, and the Ford SVT certificate. That certificate identifies this car as #5,973 of 6,513 GT500 coupes produced for 2008 and #900 of only 971 manufactured in Vapor Silver. The original window sticker shows an MSRP of $46,120 including destination, with desirable equipment including the GT500 Premium Trim Package, HID headlamps, Ebony tape stripes and full vehicle cover. The 2007–2009 Shelby GT500 has become an important part of modern Mustang history. These cars marked the return of the Shelby GT500 name and combined unmistakable retro Mustang styling with a hand-built supercharged V8, 6-speed manual transmission and 500 horsepower — serious performance then and still serious performance today. There are plenty of GT500s available that have accumulated miles, been modified, tuned, pulley-swapped and subsequently returned to stock. Finding one with just 14,130 original miles that has simply remained the way Ford built it is an entirely different proposition. This is an excellent example for the enthusiast who wants to drive and enjoy one of these cars, and an equally compelling automobile for the collector who values low mileage, originality, documentation and preservation. 14,130 original miles. Vapor Silver. 6-speed manual. Supercharged 5.4-liter V8. Accident-free history. Completely stock and unmolested. Original window sticker and SVT certificate. That's a hell of a nice package. For more info contact Kevin at Mashburn Motors. Visit Mashburn Motors online at www.mashburnmotor.com to see more pictures of this vehicle or call us at 586-468-6600 today to schedule your test drive.

The 2022 Dodge Challenger R/T Coupe 2D stands as a classic, pure-American muscle car benchmark, celebrating the legendary heritage of Dodge's classic performance coupe with unmistakable retro styling and authentic V8 power. Built on a full-size rear-wheel-drive platform, the Challenger R/T combines an assertive road presence with comfortable long-distance highway cruising capability and spacious interior seating for a performance two-door coupe.

Under the long, iconic aluminum hood with functional dual air scoops lies Dodge s naturally aspirated 5.7-liter HEMI DOHC 16-valve V8 engine. This classic powertrain produces 375 horsepower at 5,150 RPM and 410 lb-ft of torque at 4,300 RPM when paired with the standard Tremec 6-speed manual transmission (or 372 horsepower and 400 lb-ft of torque when mated to the optional TorqueFlite 8-speed automatic transmission with steering-wheel paddle shifters). Power is routed exclusively to the rear wheels through a mechanical limited-slip rear differential. Supported by a performance-tuned suspension, 4-wheel heavy-duty disc brakes, and electronic stability control, the Challenger R/T launches from 0 to 60 MPH in 5.0 seconds on its way to a top track speed of 155 MPH.

On the exterior, the 2022 Challenger R/T executes an aggressive retro visual statement defined by its split front grille, halo LED daytime running lights with illuminated Air-Catcher headlights, split LED taillamps, chrome fuel filler door, dual bright exhaust tips, and iconic HEMI fender badging. Functional exterior features include power-folding heated side mirrors, rain-sensing wipers, a rear spoiler, and a grounded stance rolling on 20-inch Satin Carbon aluminum wheels wrapped in high-performance all-season tires.

Inside, the driver-centric cockpit welcomes up to five adults into one of the largest passenger cabins in the pony car segment, lined with Houndstooth cloth sport seats (or optional Nappa leather with Alcantara suede inserts). The interior layout includes an 8-way power driver seat with 4-way power lumbar support, a leather-wrapped performance steering wheel, Dual-Zone Automatic Climate Control, Keyless Enter 'n Go proximity entry with push-button start, auto-dimming rearview mirror, and 60/40 split-folding rear seatbacks. Digital connectivity centers around the Uconnect 4 infotainment system featuring a standard 7.0-inch color touchscreen display (or optional 8.4-inch display with Navigation). System features include Apple CarPlay , Android Auto , Bluetooth phone and audio streaming, SiriusXM , Dodge Performance Pages telemetry readouts, dual USB media ports, and a 6-speaker audio system (or available 9-speaker Alpine Premium Audio System or 18-speaker Harman Kardon GreenEdge Surround Sound System).

Practicality and interior space allocation remain top-tier for a performance coupe thanks to its long 116.2-inch wheelbase. Opening the trunk lid reveals a massive 16.2 cubic feet of cargo trunk space, easily surpassing competitors like the Ford Mustang and Chevrolet Camaro. Folding the 60/40 split rear seatbacks flat further expands storage volume into the cabin for longer luggage, equipment, or travel gear.

Backed by an 18.5-gallon fuel tank, the 5.7L V8 automatic achieves an EPA-estimated 16 MPG city and 25 MPG highway (15/23 MPG with manual transmission). Safety features include Electronic Stability Control (ESC), All-Speed Traction Control, Hill Start Assist, ParkView Rear Back-Up Camera, available Blind Spot Monitoring with Rear Cross Path Detection, available Forward Collision Warning, Tire Pressure Monitoring System (TPMS), and an advanced 6-airbag protection canopy network including multistage front airbags, front seat-mounted side airbags, and full-length side-curtain airbags to guarantee absolute driving confidence.

The LS2 V8 — Raw American Muscle

Under the hood of this 2006 Corvette sits a 6.0-liter V8 engine — the legendary LS2 — producing 400 horsepower and 400 lb-ft of torque in stock form. Paired with an automatic transmission equipped with paddle shifters, this Corvette gives you the best of both worlds: the ease of automatic cruising on the 10 Freeway and the hands-on control of manual-style shifting when you want to have some real fun on a canyon road or an on-ramp. Handling and Chassis

The C6 Corvette was built on a hydroformed steel frame with a balsa wood-cored composite floor — a lightweight, rigid structure that gives this car exceptional handling dynamics. The automatic transmission in these cars is proven and generally trouble-free. description:
A Mustang does not need a V8 to feel like a Mustang, and this 2018 Ford Mustang EcoBoost makes that point with a lighter turbocharged powertrain, rear-wheel drive, and the clean fastback shape that gives the car its unmistakable presence. Finished in Gray Metallic with a cloth interior, this coupe brings together everyday usability and genuine sports-car personality in a package that works just as well for a commute through Wesley Chapel as it does for a weekend drive across Tampa Bay.

Power comes from Ford’s 2.3-liter EcoBoost four-cylinder paired here with the 10-speed automatic transmission. Turbocharging gives the engine strong midrange response, while the 10-speed provides quick ratio changes and helps keep the engine in an effective part of its power band. Rear-wheel drive preserves the traditional Mustang layout, and the independent rear suspension helps the car feel composed over real-world pavement instead of behaving like an old-school straight-line-only muscle car.

The 2018 model also brought meaningful chassis and design updates.
Revised suspension tuning, a lower hood line, updated front and rear styling, and standard dual exhaust on EcoBoost models sharpened the car’s appearance and road manners. The long hood, short rear deck, and wide stance still deliver the classic Mustang proportions, while the coupe body keeps the car compact enough to maneuver comfortably in parking lots and daily traffic.

Inside, the cabin puts the driver at the center of the experience.
Supportive front seating, a tilt-and-telescoping steering wheel, steering-wheel-mounted controls, push-button start, and a clear instrument layout make the Mustang easy to settle into. The rear seats can handle occasional passengers and also fold to extend cargo space, giving the coupe more practical flexibility than its profile might suggest. The trunk is useful for groceries, work bags, luggage, or a weekend’s worth of gear.

Technology is straightforward and focused on the functions drivers use most. Bluetooth connectivity supports hands-free calling and audio streaming, while USB connectivity and Ford’s infotainment interface make it easy to bring personal devices into the cabin. A standard rearview camera helps when backing into tighter Tampa-area spaces, and the Mustang’s relatively compact footprint makes it easier to place than a larger performance sedan or SUV.

The driving appeal comes from balance rather than excess. The EcoBoost engine provides plenty of punch for highway merging and passing, while the lighter front end gives the car an agile feel. Four-wheel disc brakes, traction control, stability control, and selectable steering effort support confident everyday driving without taking away from the rear-wheel-drive character that makes the Mustang enjoyable in the first place.

This Mustang is Ford Blue Certified, adding a 139-point inspection, a 90-day/4,000-mile Comprehensive Limited Warranty, 24/7 Roadside Assistance, and applicable FordPass Rewards Points. The certification gives buyers an added layer of reassurance while preserving the appeal of a sporty coupe that still fits normal daily life.

Parks Plus adds useful ownership benefits such as protective treatments for the vehicle’s finish and interior, VIN etching, roadside assistance, identity-theft protection and restoration, stolen-vehicle assistance, collision loyalty benefits, cabin sanitizer, and antimicrobial protectant.

For a buyer who wants a recognizable performance car without moving into a larger-engine GT, this 2018 Mustang EcoBoost is a compelling choice. It delivers turbocharged response, rear-wheel-drive balance, modern styling, and enough everyday practicality to handle commuting around Wesley Chapel, evenings in Tampa, and weekend drives throughout the greater Tampa Bay area.
